title: ECB’s Kaasik Says Understandable Why Markets See More Rate Hikes
text: ECB’s Kaasik Says Understandable Why Markets See More Rate Hikes. Investor bets on additional European Central Bank increases in borrowing costs are logical given the present situation, according to Governing Council member Ulo Kaasik.
